name: new-items-pill
title: New items pill
description: The floating pill over a live feed or chat that counts what arrived, scrolls to it on click and hides itself once the reader gets there.
docs: Put it inside a relative wrapper next to the scroller and pass scrollRef (give the scroller tabIndex 0 so it can be scrolled by keyboard); without scrollRef the page itself is watched and the pill wants a fixed position. count is how many items arrived while the reader was away. onClick runs before the scroll, so merge your buffered items there; onReach runs when the reader gets to the new content on their own, so you can merge and reset the count. label takes a string with {count}, or one, other and so on for plural forms.
